allow: Bash(powershell -NoProfile -Command 'Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq "Psy剪贴板.exe" } | Select-Object ProcessId, ExecutablePath | Format-List; "--- 开机自启注册表 ---"; Get-ItemProperty "HKCU:\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run" | Select-Object -Property *Psy* , *psy* -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Format-List; \(Get-ItemProperty "HKCU:\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run"\).PSObject.Properties | Where-Object { $_.Name -like "*psy*" -or $_.Name -like "*Psy*" } | Format-List Name, Value')

Bash(powershell -NoProfile -Command 'Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.ExecutablePath -like "*psy-clipboard*" } | Select-Object ProcessId, ExecutablePath | Format-List; "--- 开机自启注册表项 ---"; \(Get-ItemProperty "HKCU:\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run"\).PSObject.Properties | Where-Object { $_.Value -like "*psy-clipboard*" } | ForEach-Object { $_.Name + " = " + $_.Value }')

Bash(powershell -NoProfile -Command 'Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.ExecutablePath -like "*psy-clipboard*" } | Measure-Object | ForEach-Object { "安装版进程数: " + $_.Count }')

Bash(powershell -NoProfile -Command '$env:ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE = $null; $exe = Get-ChildItem "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\\Programs\\psy-clipboard" -Filter "*.exe" | Where-Object { $_.Name -notlike "Uninstall*" } | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty FullName; if \($exe\) { Start-Process -FilePath $exe; "已启动安装版: " + $exe } else { "错误:未找到应用 exe" }')
